approaches_tried.reason: Under set -uo pipefail, a bare-declared associative array that never receives an element throws 'unbound variable' on a later "${#arr[@]}" reference (bash 5.3 confirmed empirically) -- fixed by initializing with an explicit "=()".

deviations.description: Keep the file's set -uo pipefail (Class B counter-idiom harness) -- do not migrate it to -e.
deviations.reason: Discovered a bash 5.3 'declare -A arr' + set -u gotcha: a bare-declared associative array that never receives an element throws 'unbound variable' on a later "${#arr[@]}" reference (only the count form, not "${!arr[@]}" iteration). This fires exactly when zero entries carry parent_task (the real specs/state.json's current state). Fixed by initializing _d6_parent_of and _d6_cycle_members with an explicit '=()' rather than a bare declare. set -uo pipefail itself was kept unchanged, as instructed; only the new D6 variables were adjusted to be safe under it.
